python3 # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Antigravity Local Web Remote 3.5 (Натуральный интерфейс Antigravity) - Пиксель-в-пиксель дизайн боковой панели и чата Antigravity - Выбор модели (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o и др.) - Быстрые действия, голосовой ввод, список проектов из базы данных """ import os import sys import json import time import uuid import re import threading import DeepMind", "badge": "Ультра-быстрая"} ] # Очередь команд MESSAGE_QUEUE = [] QUEUE_LOCK = threading.Lock() QUEUE_EVENT = threading.Event() LAST_INJECT_TIME = 0 PENDING_NEW_CONV = None MESSAGE_QUEUE.append(item) QUEUE_EVENT.set() return item_id def update_queue_item(item_id, new_prompt): with QUEUE_LOCK: for q in MESSAGE_QUEUE: if q.get("id") == item_id: q["prompt"] = new_prompt return True return False def clean_queue_against_transcript(msgs): recent_user_texts = [m.get("text", "").strip() for m in (msgs or [])[-10:] if m.get("role") == "user"] with QUEUE_LOCK: global MESSAGE_QUEUE new_queue = [] for q in MESSAGE_QUEUE: q_text = q.get("prompt", "").strip() if q_text in recent_user_texts or q.get("status") == "sent": continue new_queue.append(q) MESSAGE_QUEUE = new_queue def get_relative_time(mtime_str): if not mtime_str: return "" try: clean_iso = mtime_str.split(".")[0] dt = datetime.fromisoformat(clean_iso).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) now = datetime.now(timezone.utc) diff = (now - dt).total_seconds() if diff < 60: return "1m" if diff < 3600: return f"{int(diff // 60)}m" if diff < 86400: return f"{int(diff // 3600)}h" days = int(diff // 86400) return f"{days}d" except Exception: return "" def parse_mtime(mtime_val): if not mtime_val: return 0.0 if isinstance(mtime_val, (int, float)): return float(mtime_val) try: clean_iso = str(mtime_val).replace(" ", "T").split("+")[0] return datetime.fromisoformat(clean_iso).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp() except Exception: return 0.0 def get_antigravity_data(): ordered_pids = [] if STORAGE_PATH.exists(): try: storage = json.loads(STORAGE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) last_pid = storage.get("lastCreatedProjectId") order = json.loads(storage.get("projectsOrder", "[]")) if last_pid and last_pid not in ordered_pids: ordered_pids.append(last_pid) for pid in order: if pid not in ordered_pids: ordered_pids.append(pid) except Exception: pass if not DB_PATH.exists(): return [], [] conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB_PATH}?mode=ro", uri=True) c = conn.cursor() projects = [] seen_conv_ids = set() for pid in ordered_pids: rows = c.execute(""" SELECT conversation_id, title, workspace_uris, last_modified_time FROM conversation_summaries WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY last_modified_time DESC """, (pid,)).fetchall() if not rows: continue proj_name = None for _, _, ws, _ in rows: if ws: try: uris = json.loads(ws) if uris and len(uris) > 0: raw = urllib.parse.unquote(uris[0]) p = Path(raw.replace("file:///", "").replace("file://", "")) proj_name = p.name if proj_name: break except Exception: pass if not proj_name: continue convs = [] for cid, title, ws, mtime in rows: seen_conv_ids.add(cid) clean_title = title if title and title.strip() and not title.strip().startswith("\ufffd") else f"Диалог {cid[:8]}" convs.append({ "id": cid, "title": clean_title, "time": get_relative_time(mtime), "mtime": mtime, "project": proj_name }) projects.append({ "id": pid, "name": proj_name, "conversations": convs }) # Диалоги ВНЕ проектов (standalone) out_rows = c.execute(""" SELECT conversation_id, title, workspace_uris, last_modified_time FROM conversation_summaries WHERE project_id = 'outside-of-project' OR project_id IS NULL OR project_id = '' ORDER BY last_modified_time DESC """).fetchall() standalone = [] if out_rows: for cid, title, ws, mtime in out_rows: seen_conv_ids.add(cid) clean_title = title if title and title.strip() and not title.strip().startswith("\ufffd") else f"Диалог {cid[:8]}" standalone.append({ "id": cid, "title": clean_title, "time": get_relative_time(mtime), "mtime": mtime, "project": "" }) conn.close() return projects, standalone def get_conversations_list(): projs, standalone = get_antigravity_data() all_convs = [] for p in projs: all_convs.extend(p["conversations"]) all_convs.extend(standalone) all_convs.sort(key=lambda x: str(x.get("mtime", "")), reverse=True) return all_convs def get_desktop_active_conv_id(): try: port_file = Path(r"C:\Users\Shestirukiy\AppData\Roaming\Antigravity\DevToolsActivePort") if not port_file.exists(): return None port = port_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[0].strip() with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json", timeout=0.6) as resp: targets = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8")) for t in targets: if t.get("type") == "page": url = t.get("url", "") m = re.search(r'/c/([a-f0-9\-]+)', url) if m: return m.group(1) except Exception: pass return None def get_active_conv_id(): global CURRENT_CONV_ID, PENDING_NEW_CONV, PENDING_NEW_TIMESTAMP # Авто-синхронизация с активным окном на ПК if CURRENT_CONV_ID != "pending_new": desktop_id = get_desktop_active_conv_id() if desktop_id and (BRAIN_DIR / desktop_id).exists(): CURRENT_CONV_ID = desktop_id return CURRENT_CONV_ID if CURRENT_CONV_ID and CURRENT_CONV_ID != "pending_new": conv_dir = BRAIN_DIR / CURRENT_CONV_ID if conv_dir.exists(): return CURRENT_CONV_ID if CURRENT_CONV_ID == "pending_new": convs = get_conversations_list() if convs: latest_ts = parse_mtime(convs[0].get("mtime")) if latest_ts >= (PENDING_NEW_TIMESTAMP - 5): CURRENT_CONV_ID = convs[0]["id"] PENDING_NEW_CONV = None return CURRENT_CONV_ID return None convs = get_conversations_list() if convs: CURRENT_CONV_ID = convs[0]["id"] return CURRENT_CONV_ID return None def get_active_info(): global PENDING_NEW_CONV active_id = get_active_conv_id() if not active_id or active_id == "pending_new": proj = PENDING_NEW_CONV.get("project_name", "") if PENDING_NEW_CONV else "" return {"id": None, "title": "Новый диалог", "project": proj, "model": CURRENT_MODEL} for c in get_conversations_list(): if c["id"] == active_id: return {"id": active_id, "title": c["title"], "project": c.get("project", ""), "model": CURRENT_MODEL} return {"id": active_id, "title": f"Диалог {active_id[:8]}", "project": "", "model": CURRENT_MODEL} def get_transcript_messages(limit=50): conv_id = get_active_conv_id() if not conv_id or conv_id == "pending_new": return [], False, "" log_dir = BRAIN_DIR / conv_id / ".system_generated" / "logs" transcript_path = log_dir / "transcript.jsonl" full_path = log_dir / "transcript_full.jsonl" if not transcript_path.exists(): return [], False, "" try: with open(transcript_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f: lines = f.readlines() full_lines = None items = [] is_working = False working_action = "" # Берем последние 120 строк для высокой скорости работы slice_lines = lines[-120:] if len(lines) > 120 else lines offset = len(lines) - len(slice_lines) for idx, line in enumerate(slice_lines): line = line.strip() if not line: continue try: data = json.loads(line) source = data.get("source", "") step_type = data.get("type", "") status = data.get("status", "") if source == "USER_EXPLICIT" or step_type == "USER_INPUT": content = data.get("content", "") clean = content.replace("", "").replace("", "").strip() if "" in clean: clean = clean.split("")[0].strip() if clean and not clean.startswith(""): items.append({ "role": "user", "text": clean, "time": data.get("created_at", "") }) elif step_type == "PLANNER_RESPONSE": # 1. Рассуждения (Thinking) thinking = data.get("thinking", "") if thinking and thinking.strip(): items.append({ "role": "thinking", "text": thinking.strip(), "time": data.get("created_at", "") }) # 2. Вызовы инструментов (Tool Calls) tool_calls = data.get("tool_calls", []) for tc in tool_calls: name = tc.get("name", "") args = tc.get("args", {}) if isinstance(args, str): try: args = json.loads(args) except Exception: pass summary = "" if isinstance(args, dict): summary = args.get("toolSummary", "") if not summary: summary = args.get("CommandLine", "") or args.get("Path", "") summary = str(summary).strip(' "\'') items.append({ "role": "tool", "name": name, "summary": summary or name, "status": "done", "time": data.get("created_at", "") }) # 3. Текстовый ответ ассистента content = data.get("content", "") if "truncated_fields" in data and "content" in data.get("truncated_fields", []): if full_lines is None and full_path.exists(): with open(full_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as ff: full_lines = ff.readlines() actual_idx = offset + idx if full_lines and actual_idx < len(full_lines): try: full_data = json.loads(full_lines[actual_idx].strip()) content = full_data.get("content", content) except Exception: pass if content and content.strip(): items.append({ "role": "assistant", "text": content.strip(), "time": data.get("created_at", "") }) elif step_type == "GENERIC": # Вывод шага инструмента if items and items[-1]["role"] == "tool": if status == "RUNNING": items[-1]["status"] = "running" is_working = True working_action = items[-1].get("summary", "Выполняется скрипт...") except Exception: continue # Проверка активного статуса агента (Working...) if lines: try: last_d = json.loads(lines[-1].strip()) if last_d.get("status") == "RUNNING": is_working = True except Exception: pass if is_working and not working_action and items: for it in reversed(items): if it.get("role") == "tool": working_action = it.get("summary", "Выполняется команда...") break elif it.get("role") == "thinking": working_action = "Рассуждает (Thinking)..." break return items[-limit:], is_working, working_action except Exception as e: print(f"Error reading transcript: {e}") return [], False, "" def execute_antigravity_injection_cdp(prompt_text): try: port_file = Path(r"C:\Users\Shestirukiy\AppData\Roaming\Antigravity\DevToolsActivePort") if not port_file.exists(): return False port = port_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[0].strip() with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json", timeout=1.5) as resp: targets = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8")) page_target = next((t for t in targets if t.get("type") == "page"), None) if not page_target: return False ws_url = page_target["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] import websockets async def _inject(): async with websockets.connect(ws_url, close_timeout=3) as ws: # 1. Check if agent is currently busy js_check = """ (() => { const cancel = document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Cancel"], button[aria-label*="Отмена"]'); if (cancel) return { busy: true }; const ed = document.querySelector('div[contenteditable="true"][role="combobox"]'); if (!ed) return { busy: true, error: "no_editor" }; // Focus editor and select all contents ed.focus(); const sel = window.getSelection(); const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(ed); range.collapse(false); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(range); return { busy: false }; })() """ await ws.send(json.dumps({ "id": 1, "method": "Runtime.evaluate", "params": {"expression": js_check, "returnByValue": True} })) r1 = json.loads(await ws.recv()) val1 = r1.get("result", {}).get("result", {}).get("value", {}) if val1.get("busy"): return False # 2. Type text using native CDP Input.insertText await ws.send(json.dumps({ "id": 2, "method": "Input.insertText", "params": {"text": prompt_text} })) await ws.recv() # Small delay to allow framework to update Send button state await asyncio.sleep(0.15) # 3. Submit via Send button click or Enter key js_submit = """ (() => { const card = document.querySelector('.bg-card'); const sendBtn = card ? card.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Send message"], button[aria-label*="Отправить"]') : null; if (sendBtn && !sendBtn.disabled) { sendBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })() """ await ws.send(json.dumps({ "id": 3, "method": "Runtime.evaluate", "params": {"expression": js_submit, "returnByValue": True} })) r3 = json.loads(await ws.recv()) val3 = r3.get("result", {}).get("result", {}).get("value", {}) # If button was not clicked, dispatch Enter key via CDP Input domain if not val3.get("clicked"): await ws.send(json.dumps({ "id": 4, "method": "Input.dispatchKeyEvent", "params": { "type": "rawKeyDown", "windowsVirtualKeyCode": 13, "unmodifiedText": "\\r", "text": "\\r", "key": "Enter", "code": "Enter" } })) await ws.recv() await ws.send(json.dumps({ "id": 5, "method": "Input.dispatchKeyEvent", "params": { "type": "keyUp", "windowsVirtualKeyCode": 13, "key": "Enter", "code": "Enter" } })) await ws.recv() return True return asyncio.run(_inject()) except Exception as e: print(f"CDP injection error: {e}") return False def execute_antigravity_injection(prompt_text): conv_id = get_active_conv_id() if conv_id and conv_id != "pending_new": scratch = BRAIN_DIR / conv_id / "scratch" scratch.mkdir(exist_ok=True) (scratch / "mobile_prompt.txt").write_text(prompt_text, encoding="utf-8") # Direct CDP injection into Chromium core return execute_antigravity_injection_cdp(prompt_text) = port_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[0].strip() with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json", timeout=1.5) as resp: targets = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8")) return data.get("result", {}).get("result", {}).get("value", {}) return asyncio.run(_trigger()) except Exception as e: print(f"[CDP Switch Conv Error] {e}") return False def queue_worker_loop(): global LAST_INJECT_TIME while True: # Wakes up immediately upon add_to_queue via QUEUE_EVENT, or every 0.3s QUEUE_EVENT.wait(timeout=0.3) QUEUE_EVENT.clear() item_to_send = None with QUEUE_LOCK: if
